# BRNDNUR Advisory LLP

> BRNDNUR Advisory LLP is an independent business advisory and brand protection consultancy based in Manjeri, Malappuram, Kerala, India. The firm assists entrepreneurs, startups, small businesses, and growing enterprises across Kerala and India with statutory trademark registration guidance, preliminary brand-name searches, classification under the Nice Agreement, brand renewals, trademark monitoring, GST registration, Udyam MSME certification, FSSAI food licensing, and business setup advisory.

## Important Regulatory Notice
BRNDNUR Advisory LLP is an independent private consultancy and is NOT a government department, court, or the official Trade Marks Registry. All trademark applications are evaluated and determined independently by the Trade Marks Registry (Office of the Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks, Government of India). No private consultancy or legal representative can guarantee trademark registration or statutory approval.

## Core Services & Guidance
- **Brand Name Search**: Preliminary phonetic, visual, and semantic conflict searches across official Trade Marks Registry database records prior to filing.
- **Trademark Registration**: End-to-end guidance under the Trade Marks Act 1999, including applicant categorization, documentation, class selection, and filing support.
- **Wordmark & Logo Protection**: Guidance on standard typography wordmarks, device marks, stylized logos, and dual-filing strategies.
- **Trademark Classes (Nice Classification)**: Strategic classification across Indian Trademark Classes 1 through 45 (Classes 1–34 for physical goods, Classes 35–45 for services).
- **Trademark Renewal & Monitoring**: Timely 10-year renewal filings under Section 25 and weekly Trade Marks Journal surveillance during the statutory 4-month opposition window.
- **Business Registration & Advisory**: GST registration, Udyam/MSME registration (which unlocks a 50% statutory government trademark fee concession), FSSAI food licensing, and entity formation advisory.
